title: The scalar localization of a linear triangulated category is triangulated
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\varpi\in R$, and let $\mathcal C$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] that is $R$-linear, with shift $[1]$ acting $R$-linearly on Hom modules. Equip the scalar localization $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization] with the induced shift, and call a triangle of $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ distinguished if it is isomorphic, in $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$, to the image under the localization functor $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ of a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal C$. Then $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ is a triangulated category, and $Q$ is an exact functor (it commutes with the shifts and carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles).

source.place: Proposition 13.5.6, Tag 05R6 (derived.tex line 1360), the triangulated structure on a localization at a multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure (Definition 13.5.1, Tag 05R2); to be applied to the saturated multiplicative system generated by the maps $\varpi^n\cdot\mathrm{id}_K$, whose localization is identified with $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$. proof.text: First obtain R-linearity of all integer shifts from the assumed R-linearity of [1]. The inverse equivalence to [1] makes [-1] linear, the zero shift is isomorphic to the identity, and induction in both directions uses the shift-addition isomorphisms. This is the proved private helper all_shift_linear.

Let M be the powers of p and V the existing Verdier rationalization [def-sfb-rationalization-quotient]. Its Hom groups are scalar localizations: the already proved scalar-fraction and equality criteria [lem-sfb-rationalization-scalar-fractions], together with [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-tensor], give the existing Rationalization.tensorHomEquiv of WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.DerivedCategory.Complete.RationalizationHom. Define E from the raw tensor-Hom category to V by X ↦ Q_V(X) and a tensor f ↦ a times Q_V(f). Identity preservation uses the pure-tensor formula at 1 tensor id. Composition preservation follows by tensor induction in both variables, composition_tmul, the functor law for Q_V and bilinearity. The Hom equivalences make E full and faithful; every object of V is isomorphic to some Q_V(X), so E is essentially surjective.

The raw functor Q followed by E is naturally isomorphic to Q_V, with identity components, because E(1 tensor f)=Q_V(f). Transfer the localization property of Q_V at its torsion-cone class W [def-sfb-rationalization-morphisms] along the inverse equivalence of E. The additive Q supplies a zero object. Precomposition with Q is fully faithful on endofunctor categories by its localization property. For every integer n take the tensor extension of [n] and the identity-component comparison Q followed by this extension ≅ [n] followed by Q. Mathlib HasShift.induced constructs the coherent shift with exactly those functors, and CommShift.ofInduced supplies the specified identity comparison with Q. Each extended functor is additive. Thus the shift-by-one equality and HEq normalization in the conclusion hold by reflexivity.

The torsion objects form a triangulated subcategory in the existing rationalization construction, so W has a calculus of left fractions and is compatible with triangulation. Apply [lem-pur-localization-triangles-05r6] directly to the raw Q, now proved to localize at this W, and the induced shift just constructed. Mathlib Triangulated.Localization.pretriangulated declares precisely the triangles isomorphic to images of distinguished triangles distinguished; isTriangulated_functor and isTriangulated give exactness of Q and TR4. Finally reorder the two witnesses (the triangle-isomorphism witness and the proof of distinguishedness) to match the requested characterization. The category remains the original tensor-Hom category throughout and no idempotent completion is taken.
